cmd: SOLIDCRAFT_REFEREE_PKG=$S/sc-referee-pkg systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 bun docs/spikes/solidcraft-referee/contract/extrude-pocket-slender.mjs (results: contract/extrude-pocket-slender-results.json). Round 1 stated a curved bar of 3e-4 (about 1e-4 observed) from squat cases only. Measured: truck's volume error depends ONLY on diag / (2 r) (same table for d1 ... d100) and runs -1.7e-4 (ratio 20-35), -3.1e-4 (45), -4.5e-4 (50), -5.7e-4 (100), -1.8e-3 (200), -2.8e-2 (500), -4.9e-2 (1000), -58% (3000 and beyond): a slender rod a student can draw gives a silently wrong volume and mass. The contract mapping computes the bound  table-error(diag/(2 r)) x curved volume / part volume  after every pull and pocket and REFUSES when it exceeds 3e-4; 0 built case(s) exceed the bar, 11 refused with the sentence below. A pocket's bound uses the volume the tool removes, so a small bore in a big plate is allowed (plate 5000 x 5000: the hole's own volume is 4.9% off but the total only 1.5e-7). Limit: only the round shapes drawn in the pull/pocket sketch itself are checked, a curved face that came from an earlier feature is not.
